title: Chess, But SCP-035 Mind Controls Your Pieces
summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with neutral SCP-035 (the mask) on b4. Each round the mask checks its neighbours; a piece adjacent to it is taken hostage as its host. With a host, the mask makes its own move after White and Black, using the host's movement pattern, heading for / attacking the nearest king (it can give check and capture). When the host is captured (or after it completes a capture), the mask respawns on an empty square, preferring squares with no adjacent pieces. Narrator feeds a pawn to the mask, which checks the black king while he forks the queen; he wins the queen and later delivers a ladder mate.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish (3600).
Neutral mask starts on b4; it 'checks' its 8 neighbours each round; an adjacent piece (either colour) becomes its host (mind-controlled, no longer owned by either player).

Turn order with a host: White, Black, then the mask moves its host using the host's normal movement, toward the nearest king (in practice the enemy king of the side that owned it? - transcript says 'attacks the nearest king').
The host can capture any piece and gives check to a king; the threatened side must respond (e.g. capture the host).
When the host is captured or its capture ends its run, the mask respawns on an empty square, preferring one with no adjacent pieces; on a cluttered board it may spawn next to one piece, dooming it.
Only one host at a time [inferred].
